excluded.reason: An oracle annotation. A module has never read cases.md and cannot produce case tags, so requiring them would fail every candidate for something it cannot know.
Human prose explaining a node or edge to a reader. Carries no graph content.
Names the command that produced a run graph. Absent from the oracle by design, per graph.schema.json, so comparing it would fail every real candidate.
Nodes and edges are sets. A graph is not more correct for having been assembled in a particular order.
